purpose: Ordinary campaign gameplay fidelity differential against the pinned original native translated program; no authored training or demo world.

source.baseOrigin: existing inspected local checkout; ROM bytes equal operator-supplied file
source.runtime: Original machine instructions translated ahead of time to C / WebAssembly; browser host scheduling patches only

harness.comparison: memcmp of the entire CPU/device/VDP/RGB structure at each native VDP frame boundary; no ignored RAM or register ranges.
harness.audioMode: AUDIO_MUTE; this differential does not establish real YMFM PCM equality.
harness.input: None: all native gamepad bits zero; empty modern pointer/action intent queues.

limitations: These three genuine mission9 continuations are not a full27mission playthrough or all subsequent12/21minute waves.
Harkonnen own-color reinforcements are not covered: the untouched idle native player is defeated before their deadline, identically in both copies.
Atreides/Ordos cases stop after the first friendly scheduled unit is actually unloaded; the second friendly unit was accepted by the native carrier and remains in transit at the stop.
Economy evidence is natural enemy-house4 harvesting/unloading and actual credited bank changes, not a player harvesting-input test.

This covers native gameplay execution and original completed RGB, not adapted-camera visual layout, touch ergonomics, browser pacing, physical hardware accuracy or real PCM. Explicit input/menu/self-action paths are separate native tests.
longRunEvidenceStatus: Historical executions with the exact headers in harness.headersSha256. Original totals/cases/hashes are unchanged; they are not presented as new long runs of the current header.

currentCompatibilityAudit.coverage: Three6000frame no-input prefixes, wholeCPU equality and natural AI economy. No fresh combat/wave/defeat/own-color/Pause/SDL claim.
